groups.title: Black Bulls
groups.def: Every registered Magic Knight of the Black Bulls squad shown in the anime.

groups.title: Golden Dawn
groups.def: Every registered Magic Knight of the Golden Dawn squad shown in the anime.

groups.title: House Vermillion
groups.def: Every member of House Vermillion shown in the anime: the siblings Fuegoleon, Leopold and Mereoleona and their cousins Mimosa and Kirsch. The first Wizard King Lumiere and his sister Tetia belong to the older Silvamillion Clover royal line (named in ep. 120 as the ancestors of both House Vermillion and House Silva), not to the house itself.

groups.title: Hage Church
groups.def: The household of the church orphanage in Hage shown in the anime: Father Orsi and Sister Lily, who run it, and Asta and Yuno, the orphans they raised there (ep. 1). The other orphans (Recca, Nash, Aruru, Hollo) aren't in this bank, and no other name here lived at the church.

groups.title: House Silva
groups.def: Every member of House Silva shown in the anime: the late Acier (flashbacks from ep. 71) and her four children Nozel, Nebra, Solid and Noelle. Lumiere and Tetia belong to the ancestral Silvamillion Clover line (ep. 120), not to the house.

groups.title: Magic Knight Captains
groups.def: Everyone shown or stated in the anime to hold a Magic Knights squad captaincy, current or former: the nine present-day captains (Yami, William, Fuegoleon, Nozel, Charlotte, Jack, Rill, Dorothy, Kaiser), Mereoleona (Crimson Lion's temporary captain from ep. 70, and leader of the Royal Knights, ep. 87), Julius (captain of the Grey Deer before becoming Wizard King, eps. 53 and 106) and the late Acier (former Silver Eagle captain, ep. 108). Vice-captains (Langris, Yuno, Kirsch, Randall, Nacht) don't count; Yuno and Nacht only become captains in the manga, and Kirsch's later captaincy is databook-only.

groups.title: Fire Magic Users
groups.def: Every character shown casting Fire Magic from their own grimoire in the anime, including Mars, whose grimoire was patched with Fana's fire affinity (ep. 18-19) - not Rhya, who can temporarily copy any attribute he witnesses, fire included.

groups.title: Water Magic Users
groups.def: Every character shown with Water as their own magic attribute in the anime, including the Seabed Temple priest Gio - not Rhya, who can temporarily copy any attribute he witnesses, water included, and not Acier, a Steel Magic user whose devil-given Water Magic is manga-only (ch. 372). Ice (Nils, Wainsley), Snow (Fragil), Mist (Nebra) and Gel (Sally) are separate attributes and don't count.

groups.title: Wind Magic Users
groups.def: Every character shown with Wind as their own magic attribute in the anime: Yuno (with Sylph), Rob (ep. 76), Fanzell (eps. 54-60) and Tetia (flashback, ep. 95). Not Rhya (copies any magic he touches; Elves and Eye avoid this group), Randall (Air Magic, ep. 98) or Kaiser (Vortex Magic, magic-cancelling whirlwinds, ep. 113); because air and whirlwinds read as wind, this group avoids every group holding Randall or Kaiser.

groups.title: Elves
groups.def: Every character in this bank who is an elf in the anime: Licht, Patolli and the Third Eye's Rhya, Vetto and Fana (elf souls reincarnated in human bodies; the Fana tile is the Third Eye member). Humans who only hosted elf spirits don't count: William (Patolli's host) and the many knights possessed during the Reincarnation arc (Rill, Charlotte, Dorothy, Luck, Gauche, Langris, Cob, Nils, Randall and others). Because Rhya can copy any magic he touches, this group avoids the Fire, Water, Wind and Spatial groups.

groups.title: Eye of the Midnight Sun
groups.def: Every willing member of the Eye of the Midnight Sun shown in the anime: its leader Patolli (who posed as 'Licht'), the Third Eye Rhya, Vetto and Fana, and Rades, Sally and Catherine (member from ep. 26, sacrificed with the others in ep. 95). Not the knights later possessed by elf spirits, not the real Licht, and not William, Patolli's host and the Eye's informant (eps. 10, 92); since a fan could argue for those two, this group avoids every group holding William or Licht, plus the attribute groups Rhya copies from.
avoid: Means Light, Dark, Night or Black

groups.title: Royal Knights
groups.def: Everyone named to the Royal Knights squad after the selection exam in the anime (ep. 87), including its leader Mereoleona and the two captains who joined, Nozel and Rill. Exam entrants who weren't picked (Magna, Sol, Finral, Leopold, Langris, Sekke, Solid, Dmitri, Rick, Curtis, Forte and others) don't count.

groups.title: Mana Zone Users
groups.def: Every character shown creating a Mana Zone, a rare feat of only the most powerful mages, in the anime (eps. 1-170). Nacht's (ch. 272 p. 11+) and Langris's (ch. 305) Mana Zones come after the anime's cutoff, so they don't count.

groups.title: Spatial Magic Users
groups.def: Every character shown casting Spatial Magic as their own attribute in the anime, including Zenon, whose devil Beelzebub gives him spatial cubes (eps. 161, 167) - not Rhya, who can temporarily copy any attribute he witnesses, spatial included, and not Lily, whose devil-given Spatial Magic is manga-only (ch. 335).

groups.title: Silver Eagle
groups.def: Every Magic Knight shown in the canon story as a current or former member of the Silver Eagle squad, including its late former captain Acier (flashback). Mohl, an ex-member who only appears in the anime-only ep. 86, isn't in this bank.

groups.title: Blue Rose
groups.def: Every registered Magic Knight of the Blue Rose squad shown in the anime.

groups.title: Crimson Lion
groups.def: Every Magic Knight shown in the anime as a current or former member of the Crimson Lion squad, including Theresa, a retired Crimson Lion turned nun.

groups.title: Aqua Deer
groups.def: Every Magic Knight shown in the anime as a member of the Aqua Deer squad: captain Rill, Cesc, Francis and Fragil. Julius, William and Yami served in Julius's old Grey Deer squad (eps. 53, 94, 106), which only a volume Q&A ties to the Aqua Deer, so they don't count; since a fan could argue for them, this group avoids every group holding them.
avoid: Means Light, Dark, Night or Black

groups.title: Green Mantis
groups.def: Every registered Magic Knight of the Green Mantis squad shown in the anime.

groups.title: Coral Peacock
groups.def: Every registered Magic Knight of the Coral Peacock squad shown in the anime.

groups.title: Purple Orca
groups.def: Every Magic Knight shown in the anime as a current or former member of the Purple Orca squad, including Rades, expelled before the series. Zora was never a member: he only knocked out the real Purple Orca vice-captain Xerx Lugner and took his place for the Royal Knights exam (ep. 73).

groups.title: Devil Hosts
groups.def: Characters shown in the anime (eps. 1-170) to carry a devil and draw on its power: Asta (Liebe, living in his grimoire; formal contract in ep. 170), Nacht (four devils, ep. 168) and the Dark Triad - Dante (Lucifero), Vanica (Megicula), Zenon (Beelzebub). Not Julius or Yami, whose devils are manga-only, nor Lolopechka, who was only cursed by Megicula.

groups.title: Seabed Temple Priests
groups.def: The Seabed Temple's priests shown in the anime (eps. 39-51): High Priest Gifso, his son Gio and Gio's children Kiato and Kahono. Visitors who fought there (the Black Bulls, Vetto) don't count, and no other universe name belongs to the temple.

groups.title: Blood Sibling in Another Squad
groups.def: Magic Knights shown in the anime to have a brother or sister by blood serving in a different squad: Noelle (Black Bulls) and her Silver Eagle siblings Nozel, Solid and Nebra; the half-brothers Finral (Black Bulls) and Langris (Golden Dawn); Kirsch (Coral Peacock) and Mimosa (Golden Dawn). Not Fuegoleon, Leopold or Mereoleona (siblings, but all Crimson Lion; Mereoleona's Royal Knights command was a one-mission detachment), not Asta and Yuno (raised together, not related), and not non-Knight siblings (Lumiere and Tetia, the Zogratis trio, Kiato and Kahono).

groups.title: Great Spirit Hosts
groups.def: Characters shown in the anime as the chosen host of one of the great elemental spirits: Yuno (Sylph, wind), Fana and later Fuegoleon (Salamander, fire) and Lolopechka (Undine, water). Not Rhya, who only copies Salamander's Breath with Imitation Magic, and not Noelle, whose bond with Undine is manga-only (ch. 295).

groups.title: Metal Magic Users
groups.def: Characters whose magic attribute in the anime is a metal: Klaus and Acier (Steel; Acier's is described in ep. 72), Nozel (Mercury), Sekke (Bronze), Ben (Copper) and Cesc (Shakudo, a copper-gold alloy). Mineral (Mars), Crystal (Rick), Rock (Curtis), Stone (Galgaria) and Sandstone (Ruben) are not metals.

groups.title: Squad Vice-Captains
groups.def: Characters shown serving as a Magic Knights squad's vice-captain during the anime's present-day story: Langris (Golden Dawn, until the time skip), Yuno (Golden Dawn, after it, ep. 159), Kirsch (Coral Peacock), Randall (Crimson Lion) and Nacht (Black Bulls, ep. 168). Yami and William, called the Grey Deer's two vice-captains in the anime-only ep. 86 flashback, are captains throughout the story and don't count; since a fan could argue for them, this group avoids every group holding them.
avoid: Means Light, Dark, Night or Black

groups.title: Means Light, Dark, Night or Black
groups.def: Names that are a word in another language for light (Licht: German/Dutch; Lumiere: French; Fana: Amharic), darkness (Yami: Japanese), night (Nacht: German/Dutch) or black (Nero: Italian, the name Luck gave Secre). Near-misses that don't count: Sol (Spanish/Latin 'sun', French 'soil'), Zora (Slavic 'dawn'), Selena (from Greek 'moon'), Nebra (from Latin 'nebula', mist) and Grey (an English colour).
